'''Nighthawks Squad''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Comprised of eight elite [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]], the squad was armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]]. One member of the squad carried a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], while another was armed with three [[luma grenade]]s and three [[Spore/B stun grenade/Legends|Spore/B stun grenades]].
